text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide seizes a stunning<n>victory at the
Takarazuka Kinen!<n>She's reached the top of the
ranks!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We discuss our upcoming race<n>schedule. Narita
Brian will most likely<n>aim for the Arima Kinen after
winning<n>the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
So we decide to shoot for the autumn<n>Tenno Sho
and work on improving<n>Biwa Hayahide's raw
speed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, I can't help but<n>notice how tired
Biwa Hayahide is. I<n>try to think of what I can do to
help.
